crons.name: PRISM Master Unit Plan - Nightly Full Pass
crons.description: Runs a large capped pass of the Master Unit Plan every night at 2 AM

crons.name: PRISM Master Unit Plan - Continuous Loop
crons.description: Continuous all-in-one loop (draft then verify) with PRISM rule enforcement. Manual/interactive runner; the two dedicated scheduled tasks cover the autonomous path.

crons.name: PRISM Unit Plan Verify
crons.description: Quick-firing verify stage: gates UNREVIEWED drafts for build-readiness, promotes passing ones into build-ready-queue.json. Installer: scripts/install-unit-plan-verify-task.ps1. Fills the drafter-drains-and-idles no-downtime gap.

crons.name: PRISM Unit Plan Build-Ready Surface
crons.description: Consumer stage (completes draft -> verify -> SURFACE): reads build-ready-queue.json read-only, routes each VERIFIED unit to its owner/lead slot, writes hermes-build-ready-next.json pointer + dashboard + throttled chat-bus advisory so specialist slots pick up work. Never builds/commits -- read/route/advertise only. Consumer hook: .claude/hooks/hermes-build-ready-inject.mjs. Installer: scripts/install-hermes-build-ready-loop-task.ps1.

crons.name: PRISM Unit Plan Requeue Rework
crons.description: Loop-closure stage (draft -> verify -> REQUEUE -> redraft): re-drafts NEEDS-REWORK units the verify stage dropped from build-ready-queue AND the drafter skips (Status=Drafted). Backs up the failing draft, resets Status=Not Started, re-drafts at a higher token budget (PRISM_UNITPLAN_REDRAFT_MAX_TOKENS, default 12000 -- truncation is the usual NEEDS-REWORK cause). Structural (split/replace) verdicts + units past REDRAFT_CAP(2) surface needs-human, never looped. Closes the only remaining no-downtime dead-end. Disable: PRISM_UNITPLAN_REDRAFT_DISABLE=1.

crons.name: PRISM Efficiency Optimization - Weekly Review
crons.description: Weekly review and optimization pass on Claude Code CLI efficiency
